column1: # Material-specific display rules for the GT6 material naming function.
# Columns: materials (comma separated) <TAB> prefix condition <TAB> name template
# Condition: "=name" exact prefix name, "name*" prefix name prefix, "#TAG|TAG" any prefix tag, "*" any prefix.
# Template: {before}, {after} and {local} resolve from the prefix and the material display name;
# Rules are evaluated in file order per material; the first matching condition wins.
